text_block_list.text:
When I ask Mejiro Ramonu if she was able 
to get some good rest—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...The savory aroma of spices, and 
overflowing meat juices...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And a sweet fruit dripping with juice... 
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was able to replenish plenty of 
blessings at the buffet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
With this, love's fulfillment―― must 
surely be one step closer.

It looks like Mejiro Ramonu was able to 
enjoy a fulfilling break!
